snippet.title: S.E.X. Project: Simulated Emotional Xenotech | Official Launch Trailer (PS5)
snippet.description:
This Sci-Fi Game About AI and Emotions Is Out Now on PlayStation 5.

S.E.X. Project: Simulated Emotional Xenotech is available today.

Step into a sci-fi experience where emotions are engineered and connections with synthetic beings blur the line between real and artificial. Explore a narrative-driven world focused on atmosphere, interaction, and emotional depth.

🎮 Now available on PlayStation 5
